mechanism: Both berberine and praziquantel undergo hepatic metabolism via CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, with potential for competition and increased praziquantel exposure; berberine may also inhibit P-glycoprotein affecting praziquantel distribution.
action: Monitor for increased praziquantel adverse effects (dizziness, GI symptoms); consider spacing doses or therapeutic drug monitoring if concurrent use is necessary.
